concepts.name: Unit 4 Electromagnetism Introduction Ele
concepts.simple_definition: Unit 4 Electromagnetism Introduction Electromagnetism is one of the fundamental force in nature consisting of the elements electricity and magnetism
concepts.deep_explanation: It involves the study of electromagnetic force
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Unit 4 Electromagnetism Introduction Ele from page 123.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Unit 4 Electromagnetism Introduction Ele with adjacent topics in Chapter 4.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] Unit 4 Electromagnetism Introduction Electromagnetism is one of the fundamental force in nature consisting of the elements electricity and magnetism (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ12ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] It involves the study of electromagnetic force — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 123 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።
